A '''Jenet criminal''' was present in a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in the [[Lizil (Hive)|Lizil]] [[Lizil|nest]] in [[35 ABY/Legends|35 ABY]]. [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Mara Jade Skywalker]], and [[Saba Sebatyne]] witnessed the [[Jenet/Legends|Jenet]] accepting visitors in the cantina during the [[Swarm War]].
